You are a senior Python engineer on a hackathon team (demo today 14:00, hand-in 12:00). Build a GENERIC "paper check" agent that finds contradictions between supplier documents and the ERP on its own, replacing hand-curated demo cards. The challenge rule (docs/challenge.md): "Nothing hardcoded. Never copy values from the data into code… new files land unannounced… handle new and changed files without a rebuild… surface contradictions instead of silently picking one side." Work in the repo directly; do NOT commit or push. Others work in parallel on other files: you may ONLY create/edit src/ask_soony/papercheck.py, scripts/demo_cards.py, src/ask_soony/background.py (only to hook your loop in, keep existing behaviour), tests/test_papercheck.py (and tests/conftest.py only to add fixtures). Do NOT edit src/ask_soony/api.py, routines.py, anchors.py, launch.py or anything in web/.

Repo /Users/jonasstenglein/OtherProjects/StartMunichHack/ask-soony. Read first: docs/challenge.md; src/ask_soony/api.py build_cards (how findings.json / decisions.json / impacts.json in data/state become inbox cards: findings with id, kind, title, summary, part, supplier, status, level, created_at, sides[{source, value, doc, page, quote, translation, language}], trail[{agent, at, text}]; decisions with finding_id, headline, level, reason, deadline, options[{action, cost, effect, channel ('email'|'notify'|None), to, draft, recommended}]; impacts with finding_id, copies_at_risk, edition, deadline); scripts/demo_cards.py (the hand-curated version you replace: its cases are the ground truth your generic checks should re-discover); src/ask_soony/anchors.py (an index of every portal file with text per PDF page, OCR words for scans/images, table rows; cached under data/store/anchors/; reuse it for document text instead of re-reading files: `anchors.build_index()` then iterate `anchors._index` {doc: [units]}); src/ask_soony/cardtools.py supplier_addresses(); the portal mirror data/portal (soony/erp/*.csv: purchase_orders_2025H2-2026.csv, goods_receipts.csv, stock_snapshot.csv, open_shipments.csv; soony/master/* incl. bom and bom_delta_*.csv (engineering changes); soony/context/launch_plan_GH6.xlsx; suppliers/<id>/{profile.*, order_confirmations/*.pdf, notices/*}; soony/receiving/DC-HAM/* scans and inspection reports). Discover file names and columns at runtime (glob, header names), never hardcode PO numbers, part ids, file names or values.

Design:
1. Claims: for each supplier-side document (order confirmations, shipping advices, delivery notes/scans, notices, inspection reports; classify by content, not by file name alone), extract structured claims: doc type, PO number(s), per line: material/part id, ordered qty, confirmed/shipped qty, balance, dates (confirmed/ship/arrival), artwork/revision, status statements (on hold, short shipment, does not meet AQL, blocked), each with a verbatim quote and page. Use deterministic extraction (regex + table parsing on the anchor index text, numbers normalised with anchors.norm) where reliable, and an LLM call per document for the rest (OpenAI via httpx, model env ASK_PAPERCHECK_MODEL default gpt-4.1-mini, key OPENAI_API_KEY from .env via ask_soony.config.load_dotenv; for scans you may send the image to the vision model to catch handwritten corrections). Cache claims per document content hash under <ASK_DATA_DIR or data/store>/papercheck/ so re-runs and new drops only process new/changed files. Keep total LLM cost small (gpt-4.1-mini; skip documents with no PO/part reference); log how many calls. If no key: deterministic only.
2. Rules (generic, each a small function, documented): (a) shipped/confirmed qty < open PO line qty or a stated balance arriving after the PO's promised date / after the launch deadline (launch from soony context/launch files if discoverable, else env ASK_LAUNCH_AT) → "arrives after launch / short shipment"; (b) document revision ≠ current revision per the latest BOM change (ECN "must not be packed") → "old revision confirmed"; (c) goods receipt qty ≠ delivery note qty (incl. handwritten corrections) → "stock booked wrong"; (d) inspection says lot failed but stock is unrestricted → "failed lot counted as stock"; (e) supplier refuses/holds (e.g. incoterm dispute, "on hold") while ERP shows booked/open → "held at supplier". Each finding: sides = system (ERP file + row key fields + value) vs document (path, page, verbatim quote, translation if not English), impact (copies at risk per edition via BOM usage and remaining need where derivable; else units affected, clearly labelled), options (free communication options first: email the supplier contact from its profile with a short specific draft, or notify an internal role; options with money only when the data names a price/offer) and a trail (Watcher found <file>, Paper check matched <ERP row>, …). Level: red if it stops a line/edition before launch, amber otherwise. Stable ids: "paper-<po>-<part>-<rule>" (the existing Hwaseong card id paper-4500318735-CMP-GAM-001 should be reproduced by rule (a) or kept compatible).
3. Wire-up: `python -m ask_soony.papercheck` (or a function `run(write=True)`) writes findings/decisions/impacts into data/state (merge by id, keep others, do not overwrite decision status); hook into background.start() so it runs at startup and after each portal poll when ASK_BACKGROUND=on (cheap when cached). Make scripts/demo_cards.py a thin wrapper: `--reset` keeps its current reset behaviour (backups, clear decisions, routines off) and removes its own old hand-curated entries, then runs papercheck; no hand-written document references remain in it.
4. Verify on the real portal: it must re-discover at least: Hwaseong PO 4500318735 short shipment (20,000 arrive Tue 24 Nov after launch), the 4 PackRight sleeve POs confirmed with rev B, the statue lot that failed inspection but is unrestricted, the art book receipt booked 80,000 vs 8,000 (scan correction). Report precision honestly (false positives found, e.g. "128 GB" parsed as a quantity; the magnet BOM double count is NOT a problem). Check that anchors.find() locates each document side (so the UI can highlight it). Never approve cards or send email.
5. Tests: unit tests for each rule on small synthetic data (tests/test_papercheck.py; synthetic portal in tmp_path, LLM disabled), plus idempotent merge. `uv run pytest -q` all pass; `uv run ruff check src tests scripts --exclude tests/test_platform.py` clean (line length 100; multi-line docstrings start with """ alone on the first line; no em dashes).
Final report: rules, what it found on the real data (list), false positives, LLM calls/cost, how to run, test results.

"""
Demo cards from the real portal data: writes findings, decisions and impacts into data/state.

Every quantity, date, price and address on a card is read from the portal files at run time
(SAP exports, stock snapshot, pack-out log, supplier profiles). Only the document references live
in this script: which goods receipt or PO a case is about, which file and page shows the other
side, and the verbatim text that proves it. A case whose files or rows are missing, or whose
document no longer says what the script expects, is skipped with a warning.

Entries are merged by id (other entries stay), so running it twice changes nothing but the
timestamps. Nothing is approved and no email is sent.

    uv run python scripts/demo_cards.py            # add or refresh the demo cards
    uv run python scripts/demo_cards.py --reset    # also clear decisions, actions, replies,
                                                   # Teams posts and drafts; switch routines off

--reset first backs up every file it changes as <name>.before-demo-<timestamp>.json.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import re
import shutil
import sys
from datetime import datetime, time, timedelta
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "src"))
from ask_soony import api  # noqa: E402

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- document references (data)

ART_BOOKS = {
    "gr": "5000413065",
    "scan": "soony/receiving/DC-HAM/20261118_WZ-261116-473.jpg",
    "scan_quote": "Nr: WZ-261116-473 · Zamówienie: 4500318768 · CMP-GAM-008 · Ilość 80.000 "
    "(struck through), 8 000 (handwritten) · Waga brutto: 360 kg · Opak.: 40",
    "scan_translation": "Delivery note: the printed 80,000 is crossed out and corrected by hand "
    "to 8,000 (40 packages, 360 kg).",
    "offer": "suppliers/SUP-0028_Karton_Nowak/notices/Oferta_tryb_ekspresowy_2026-11-21.pdf",
    "offer_checks": ["8,000 pcs", "overrun from", "loaded"],
    "offer_quote": "CMP-GAM-008 Art Book Grand Heist 6 (96 p, hardcover) · 8 000 szt. / 8,000 pcs "
    "· overrun from production, in our finished-goods store · loaded within 4 h of your order",
    "offer_qty": 8000,
    "supplier_dir": "suppliers/SUP-0028_Karton_Nowak",
    "decide_by": time(10, 0),
    "lead_h": 1,
}

SLEEVES = {
    "ecn": "ECN-2026-118",
    "pos": ["4500318752", "4500318765", "4500318774", "4500318786"],
    "supplier_dir": "suppliers/SUP-0029_Guangzhou_PackRight",
    "supplier_part": "PR-SL-0604",
    "old_quote": "Artwork PR-SL-0604: rev. B (GH6_sleeve_revB.pdf)",
    # Karton Nowak already prints to the released file; its confirmations name it.
    "new_file_doc": "suppliers/SUP-0028_Karton_Nowak/order_confirmations/OA26293887_4500318775.pdf",
    "new_file": "GH6_sleeve_revC_USK2026.pdf",
    "decide_by": time(12, 0),
    "lead_h": 3,
}

STATUES = {
    "gr": "5000413063",
    "report": "soony/receiving/DC-HAM/inspection_report_5000413063.pdf",
    "report_checks": ["Lot does not meet AQL", "unrestricted", "concession"],
    "report_quote": "Goods receipt 5000413063 · 5,600 · 9 of 125 statues with paint defects. "
    "Lot does not meet AQL. Booked to stock as 'unrestricted' by receiving because the supplier "
    "is listed as active.",
    "decide_by": time(10, 0),
    "lead_h": 1,
}

RESET_FILES = {
    "decision_status.json": {},
    "actions.json": [],
    "replies_seen.json": [],
    "teams_posted.json": [],
    "routine_drafts.json": {},
}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- portal helpers


def warn(msg: str) -> None:
    print(f"warning: {msg}", file=sys.stderr)


def n(v) -> int:
    return int(api.num(v) or 0)


def fmt(v: float) -> str:
    return f"{v:,.0f}"


def fmt_date(value: str) -> str:
    try:
        return datetime.fromisoformat(value).strftime("%a %-d %b")
    except ValueError:
        return value


def csvs(root: Path, folder: str, pattern: str) -> list[dict]:
    rows: list[dict] = []
    for f in sorted((root / folder).glob(pattern)):
        rows += [{**r, "_file": str(f.relative_to(root))} for r in api.read_csv(f)]
    return rows


def pdf_text(path: Path) -> str:
    try:
        import pypdfium2 as pdfium

        doc = pdfium.PdfDocument(str(path))
        text = " ".join(page.get_textpage().get_text_range() for page in doc)
    except Exception:  # unreadable or not a PDF
        return ""
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text)


def says(root: Path, rel: str, checks: list[str]) -> bool:
    """The document exists and (for a PDF with a text layer) contains every check string."""
    path = root / rel
    if not path.is_file():
        warn(f"{rel} is missing")
        return False
    if path.suffix.lower() != ".pdf":
        return True
    text = pdf_text(path)
    missing = [c for c in checks if re.sub(r"\s+", " ", c) not in text]
    if missing:
        warn(f"{rel} no longer says {missing}")
    return not missing


def contact(root: Path, supplier_dir: str) -> dict:
    rows = api.read_csv(root / supplier_dir / "profile.csv")
    return rows[0] if rows else {}


def stock(root: Path) -> tuple[list[dict], str]:
    rows = csvs(root, "soony/erp", "stock_snapshot*.csv")
    return rows, max((r.get("snapshot_date") or "" for r in rows), default="")


def to_pack(root: Path, part: str, snapshot: str) -> tuple[str, int]:
    """Edition that needs this part and the copies still to pack as of the stock snapshot."""
    bom = [r for r in csvs(root, "soony/master", "bom.csv") if r.get("child_id") == part]
    launch = {
        r["product_id"]: r
        for r in csvs(root, "soony/master", "products.csv")
        if r.get("lifecycle") == "launch"
    }
    for b in bom:
        p = launch.get(b.get("parent_id") or "")
        if not p:
            continue
        packed = sum(
            n(r.get("units_packed"))
            for r in csvs(root, "soony/erp", "packout_log*.csv")
            if r.get("product_id") == p["product_id"] and (r.get("date") or "") <= snapshot
        )
        return p["product_id"], (n(p.get("day_one_qty")) - packed) * n(b.get("qty_per") or 1)
    return "", 0


def launch_day(root: Path) -> datetime:
    dates = [
        r["launch_date"]
        for r in csvs(root, "soony/master", "products.csv")
        if r.get("lifecycle") == "launch" and r.get("launch_date")
    ]
    day = datetime.fromisoformat(min(dates)) if dates else api.now()
    return day.replace(tzinfo=api.tz())


def deadline(root: Path, at: time, lead_h: float, cur: datetime) -> str:
    """The case's decide-by time on launch day, but never less than lead_h from now."""
    fixed = datetime.combine(launch_day(root).date(), at, tzinfo=api.tz())
    soon = cur + timedelta(hours=lead_h)
    soon = soon.replace(minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0) + timedelta(hours=1)
    return max(fixed, soon).isoformat()


def trail(cur: datetime, steps: list[tuple[str, str]]) -> list[dict]:
    start = cur - timedelta(minutes=2 * len(steps))
    return [
        {
            "agent": a,
            "at": (start + timedelta(minutes=2 * i)).isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
            "text": t,
        }
        for i, (a, t) in enumerate(steps)
    ]


def po_line(po: dict) -> str:
    return (
        f"PO {po['po_number']} line {po['po_line']} · {po['material_id']} · {po['quantity']} pcs "
        f"· promised {po['promised_date']} · {po['status']}"
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- cases


Card = tuple[dict, dict, dict]


def art_books(root: Path, cur: datetime) -> list[Card]:
    c = ART_BOOKS
    gr = next(
        (
            r
            for r in csvs(root, "soony/erp", "goods_receipts*.csv")
            if r.get("gr_number") == c["gr"]
        ),
        None,
    )
    if gr is None:
        warn(f"goods receipt {c['gr']} not found")
        return []
    if not (says(root, c["scan"], []) and says(root, c["offer"], c["offer_checks"])):
        return []
    part, po_no, ordered, booked = (
        gr["material_id"],
        gr["po_number"],
        n(gr["qty_ordered"]),
        n(gr["qty_received"]),
    )
    rows, snapshot = stock(root)
    system = sum(n(r.get("quantity")) for r in rows if r.get("material_id") == part)
    real = system - booked + ordered
    edition, need = to_pack(root, part, snapshot)
    short = max(0, need - real)
    po = next(
        (
            r
            for r in csvs(root, "soony/erp", "purchase_orders*.csv")
            if r.get("po_number") == po_no and r.get("po_line") == gr.get("po_line")
        ),
        {},
    )
    price, currency = api.num(po.get("unit_price")) or 0, po.get("currency") or "EUR"
    who = contact(root, c["supplier_dir"])
    offer_name = Path(c["offer"]).name
    fid = f"gr-{c['gr']}-{part}"
    finding = {
        "id": fid,
        "kind": "mismatch",
        "part": part,
        "supplier": gr.get("supplier_id"),
        "title": f"SAP counts {fmt(system)} art books; the shelf holds {fmt(real)}",
        "summary": (
            f"Goods receipt {c['gr']} booked {fmt(booked)} for PO {po_no} line {gr['po_line']} "
            f"(ordered {fmt(ordered)}, remark '{gr.get('remark')}'). The delivery note "
            f"{gr.get('delivery_note')} was corrected by hand to {fmt(ordered)}."
        ),
        "status": "open",
        "level": "red",
        "created_at": cur.isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
        "sides": [
            {
                "source": "System says · SAP goods receipt",
                "value": f"{fmt(booked)} received on GR {c['gr']} (ordered {fmt(ordered)})",
                "doc": gr["_file"],
                "quote": (
                    f"GR {c['gr']} · PO {po_no} line {gr['po_line']} · {part} · ordered {ordered}"
                    f" · received {booked} · {gr.get('remark')}"
                ),
            },
            {
                "source": "System says · SAP stock",
                "value": f"{fmt(system)} art books in stock on {snapshot}",
                "doc": next((r["_file"] for r in rows if r.get("material_id") == part), None),
                "quote": f"{part} · batch {c['gr']} · {booked} PC",
            },
            {
                "source": f"Paper says · delivery note {gr.get('delivery_note')} (PL)",
                "value": f"{fmt(ordered)} delivered, not {fmt(booked)}",
                "doc": c["scan"],
                "page": 1,
                "language": "pl",
                "quote": c["scan_quote"],
                "translation": c["scan_translation"],
            },
            {
                "source": "Supplier offer · Karton Nowak rush service (PL/EN)",
                "value": f"{fmt(c['offer_qty'])} art books in stock, loaded within 4 h",
                "doc": c["offer"],
                "page": 1,
                "language": "pl",
                "quote": c["offer_quote"],
            },
        ],
        "trail": trail(
            cur,
            [
                ("Watcher", f"Read the delivery note scan {Path(c['scan']).name} from DC Hamburg."),
                (
                    "Verification",
                    f"Matched GR {c['gr']} in SAP: {fmt(booked)} booked against "
                    f"{fmt(ordered)} ordered; the scan shows {fmt(ordered)}.",
                ),
                (
                    "Impact",
                    f"{fmt(real)} art books for {fmt(need)} Collector's copies still to pack: "
                    f"{fmt(short)} short.",
                ),
            ],
        ),
    }
    decision = {
        "finding_id": fid,
        "level": "red",
        "headline": f"We have {fmt(real)} art books, not {fmt(system)}. The Collector's cell runs "
        f"out about {fmt(short)} copies early.",
        "reason": "Karton Nowak has art books in stock and can load a truck within hours; the "
        "goods receipt should be corrected too, so SAP stops hiding the gap.",
        "deadline": deadline(root, c["decide_by"], c["lead_h"], cur),
        "options": [
            {
                "action": f"Order Karton Nowak's {fmt(c['offer_qty'])} art books from stock "
                "(truck tonight)",
                "cost": f"about {currency} {fmt(c['offer_qty'] * price)}",
                "effect": f"covers the {fmt(short)} gap; Poznań to Hamburg is about 9 h by truck",
                "channel": "email",
                "to": who.get("contact_email"),
                "recommended": True,
                "draft": (
                    f"Dear {who.get('contact_name') or 'Karton Nowak team'},\n\n"
                    f"thank you for your rush offer ({offer_name}). We would like to order the "
                    f"{fmt(c['offer_qty'])} Art Books Grand Heist 6 ({part}) from your "
                    "finished-goods store at the Annex A price, delivered to DC Hamburg.\n\n"
                    "Please load them on the next truck and send us the truck details and the "
                    "delivery note number.\n\n"
                    "Best regards,\nSoony Procurement"
                ),
            },
            {
                "action": f"Ask receiving to correct the goods receipt to {fmt(ordered)}",
                "cost": "No cost",
                "effect": "SAP shows the real stock again",
                "channel": "notify",
                "to": "DC receiving",
                "draft": (
                    f"Please correct goods receipt {c['gr']} (PO {po_no} line {gr['po_line']}) "
                    f"from {fmt(booked)} to {fmt(ordered)}: delivery note "
                    f"{gr.get('delivery_note')} was corrected by hand to {fmt(ordered)}."
                ),
            },
        ],
    }
    impact = {
        "finding_id": fid,
        "copies_at_risk": short,
        "edition": edition,
        "deadline": decision["deadline"],
    }
    return [(finding, decision, impact)]


def sleeves(root: Path, cur: datetime) -> list[Card]:
    c = SLEEVES
    ecn = next(
        (r for r in csvs(root, "soony/master", "bom_delta*.csv") if r.get("change_id") == c["ecn"]),
        None,
    )
    if ecn is None:
        warn(f"{c['ecn']} not found")
        return []
    if not says(root, c["new_file_doc"], [c["new_file"]]):
        return []
    part, old, new = ecn["child_id"], ecn.get("rev_old"), ecn.get("rev_new")
    who = contact(root, c["supplier_dir"])
    pos = csvs(root, "soony/erp", "purchase_orders*.csv")
    out: list[Card] = []
    for po_no in c["pos"]:
        lines = [
            r
            for r in pos
            if r.get("po_number") == po_no
            and r.get("material_id") == part
            and r.get("status") == "open"
        ]
        oa = sorted((root / c["supplier_dir"] / "order_confirmations").glob(f"OA*_{po_no}.pdf"))
        if not lines or not oa:
            warn(f"PO {po_no}: no open {part} line or no order confirmation")
            continue
        oa_rel = str(oa[0].relative_to(root))
        if not says(root, oa_rel, [c["old_quote"]]):
            continue
        qty = sum(n(r["quantity"]) for r in lines)
        due = " / ".join(fmt_date(r["promised_date"]) for r in lines)
        oa_no = oa[0].name.split("_")[0]
        fid = f"rev-{po_no}-{part}"
        finding = {
            "id": fid,
            "kind": "revision",
            "part": part,
            "supplier": lines[0].get("supplier_id"),
            "title": f"PackRight confirmed PO {po_no} with the old sleeve artwork (rev {old})",
            "summary": (
                f"{c['ecn']} moved {part} from rev {old} to rev {new} ({ecn.get('reason')}). "
                f"PackRight's confirmation {oa_no} still prints {fmt(qty)} sleeves to rev {old}."
            ),
            "status": "open",
            "level": "amber",
            "created_at": cur.isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
            "sides": [
                {
                    "source": "System says · SAP purchase order",
                    "value": f"{fmt(qty)} sleeves due {due}, open",
                    "doc": lines[0]["_file"],
                    "quote": " ; ".join(po_line(r) for r in lines),
                },
                {
                    "source": f"Paper says · PackRight order confirmation {oa_no} (EN)",
                    "value": f"artwork rev. {old}",
                    "doc": oa_rel,
                    "page": 1,
                    "language": "en",
                    "quote": f"PO {po_no} · {c['supplier_part']} · "
                    + " / ".join(fmt(n(r["quantity"])) for r in lines)
                    + f" · {c['old_quote']}",
                },
                {
                    "source": f"Engineering change {c['ecn']}",
                    "value": f"rev {old} to rev {new}, rev {old} must not be packed",
                    "doc": ecn["_file"],
                    "quote": f"{c['ecn']} · {part} · rev {old} to {new} · {ecn.get('reason')}",
                },
            ],
            "trail": trail(
                cur,
                [
                    ("Watcher", f"Read {Path(ecn['_file']).name}: {part} moves to rev {new}."),
                    (
                        "Verification",
                        f"Checked PackRight's confirmation {oa_no} for PO {po_no}: "
                        f"artwork rev. {old}.",
                    ),
                    (
                        "Verification",
                        f"Matched PO {po_no} in SAP: {fmt(qty)} sleeves due {due}, still open.",
                    ),
                ],
            ),
        }
        decision = {
            "finding_id": fid,
            "level": "amber",
            "headline": f"PackRight confirmed PO {po_no} with the old sleeve artwork (rev {old})",
            "reason": f"Sleeves printed to rev {old} cannot be packed. It is still free to fix "
            "before printing starts.",
            "deadline": deadline(root, c["decide_by"], c["lead_h"], cur),
            "options": [
                {
                    "action": f"Ask PackRight to print PO {po_no} to artwork rev {new}",
                    "cost": "No cost",
                    "effect": f"{fmt(qty)} sleeves usable after launch",
                    "channel": "email",
                    "to": who.get("contact_email"),
                    "recommended": True,
                    "draft": (
                        f"Dear {who.get('contact_name') or 'PackRight team'},\n\n"
                        f"your order confirmation {oa_no} for PO {po_no} confirms artwork "
                        f"{c['supplier_part']} rev. {old}. Our part {part} changed to rev. {new} "
                        f"({c['ecn']}); sleeves printed to rev. {old} cannot be packed.\n\n"
                        f"Please print PO {po_no} to artwork rev. {new} ({c['new_file']}) and "
                        "send us a corrected order confirmation. If you do not have the file, "
                        "reply and we will send it today.\n\n"
                        "Best regards,\nSoony Procurement"
                    ),
                },
                {
                    "action": "Tell the category lead",
                    "cost": "No cost",
                    "effect": "the category lead follows up with PackRight",
                    "channel": "notify",
                    "to": "Category lead",
                    "draft": f"PackRight confirmed PO {po_no} ({fmt(qty)} sleeves) with artwork "
                    f"rev {old}; {c['ecn']} requires rev {new}.",
                },
            ],
        }
        impact = {
            "finding_id": fid,
            "units_short": qty,
            "edition": ecn.get("parent_id"),
            "deadline": decision["deadline"],
        }
        out.append((finding, decision, impact))
    return out


def statues(root: Path, cur: datetime) -> list[Card]:
    c = STATUES
    gr = next(
        (
            r
            for r in csvs(root, "soony/erp", "goods_receipts*.csv")
            if r.get("gr_number") == c["gr"]
        ),
        None,
    )
    if gr is None:
        warn(f"goods receipt {c['gr']} not found")
        return []
    if not says(root, c["report"], c["report_checks"]):
        return []
    part, lot = gr["material_id"], n(gr["qty_received"])
    rows, snapshot = stock(root)
    total = sum(n(r.get("quantity")) for r in rows if r.get("material_id") == part)
    batch = sum(
        n(r.get("quantity"))
        for r in rows
        if r.get("material_id") == part and r.get("batch") == c["gr"]
    )
    usable = total - batch
    edition, need = to_pack(root, part, snapshot)
    short = max(0, need - usable)
    fid = f"qa-{c['gr']}-{part}"
    finding = {
        "id": fid,
        "kind": "quality",
        "part": part,
        "supplier": gr.get("supplier_id"),
        "title": f"{fmt(batch)} statues in stock failed incoming inspection",
        "summary": (
            f"Goods receipt {c['gr']} (PO {gr['po_number']}) put {fmt(lot)} statues in stock as "
            "unrestricted, but the inspection report rejects the lot. Without them "
            f"{fmt(usable)} statues are usable for {fmt(need)} Collector's copies."
        ),
        "status": "open",
        "level": "red",
        "created_at": cur.isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
        "sides": [
            {
                "source": "System says · SAP stock",
                "value": f"{fmt(batch)} statues on GR {c['gr']}, {fmt(total)} in stock",
                "doc": next((r["_file"] for r in rows if r.get("batch") == c["gr"]), None),
                "quote": f"{part} · batch {c['gr']} · {batch} PC",
            },
            {
                "source": "Paper says · incoming inspection report (EN)",
                "value": f"GR {c['gr']} · {fmt(lot)} statues rejected (AQL 1.0)",
                "doc": c["report"],
                "page": 1,
                "language": "en",
                "quote": c["report_quote"],
            },
        ],
        "trail": trail(
            cur,
            [
                ("Watcher", f"Read {Path(c['report']).name} from DC Hamburg."),
                (
                    "Verification",
                    f"Matched GR {c['gr']} in SAP: {fmt(lot)} statues booked "
                    "unrestricted; the report rejects the lot.",
                ),
                (
                    "Impact",
                    f"{fmt(usable)} usable statues for {fmt(need)} Collector's copies: "
                    f"{fmt(short)} short.",
                ),
            ],
        ),
    }
    decision = {
        "finding_id": fid,
        "level": "red",
        "headline": f"{fmt(batch)} statues on the shelf failed inspection. Without them we are "
        f"{fmt(short)} Collector's copies short.",
        "reason": "The report allows use only under a concession signed by Supplier Quality and "
        "the category lead; a 100% sort could free the good statues today.",
        "deadline": deadline(root, c["decide_by"], c["lead_h"], cur),
        "options": [
            {
                "action": "Ask Supplier Quality and the category lead for a concession or a "
                "100% sort today",
                "cost": "No cost",
                "effect": "the good statues of the lot can be packed",
                "channel": "notify",
                "to": "Supplier Quality, Category lead",
                "recommended": True,
                "draft": (
                    f"Goods receipt {c['gr']} (PO {gr['po_number']}, {fmt(lot)} statues {part}) "
                    "failed incoming inspection but is booked unrestricted. Without it we are "
                    f"{fmt(short)} Collector's copies short. Please decide today: a concession "
                    "or a 100% sort at DC Hamburg."
                ),
            },
        ],
    }
    impact = {
        "finding_id": fid,
        "copies_at_risk": short,
        "edition": edition,
        "deadline": decision["deadline"],
    }
    return [(finding, decision, impact)]


CASES = (art_books, sleeves, statues)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- writing


def merge(name: str, key: str, entries: list[dict]) -> None:
    new = {e[key]: e for e in entries}
    kept = [e for e in api.read_list(name) if e.get(key) not in new]
    api.write_json(name, kept + list(new.values()))


def backup(name: str, stamp: str) -> None:
    path = api.state_dir() / name
    if path.exists():
        shutil.copy2(path, path.with_name(f"{path.stem}.before-demo-{stamp}.json"))


def reset(stamp: str) -> None:
    for name, empty in RESET_FILES.items():
        backup(name, stamp)
        api.write_json(name, empty)
    backup("routines.json", stamp)
    routines = api.read_list("routines.json")
    for r in routines:
        r["enabled"] = False
    api.write_json("routines.json", routines)


def build(root: Path, cur: datetime) -> list[Card]:
    cards: list[Card] = []
    for case in CASES:
        try:
            cards += case(root, cur)
        except (KeyError, ValueError) as exc:  # a file changed shape: skip this case only
            warn(f"{case.__name__} skipped: {exc!r}")
    return cards


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.split("\n\n")[0] if __doc__ else None)
    ap.add_argument("--reset", action="store_true", help="clear decisions, actions and routines")
    args = ap.parse_args(argv)
    root = api.portal_root()
    if root is None:
        print("No portal data found under data/ (set ASK_PORTAL_DIR).", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    cur = api.now()
    if args.reset:
        reset(cur.strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S"))
    cards = build(root, cur)
    merge("findings.json", "id", [f for f, _, _ in cards])
    merge("decisions.json", "finding_id", [d for _, d, _ in cards])
    merge("impacts.json", "finding_id", [i for _, _, i in cards])
    for f, d, _ in cards:
        print(f"{f['id']}: {d['headline']}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
"""
Background loops of the product, started inside the dashboard app so everything runs as one
server: the portal watcher, alert escalation and the supplier reply poller.

Only with ASK_BACKGROUND=on in the process environment (tests and local UI work stay quiet).
ASK_REPLY_POLL=on alone still starts just the reply poller.
"""

import os
import sys
import threading

ON = ("1", "on", "true", "yes")


def _watcher() -> None:
    from ask_soony.cli import _analyst
    from ask_soony.config import Settings
    from ask_soony.notify import build_notifiers
    from ask_soony.portal import PortalClient
    from ask_soony.store import Store
    from ask_soony.watcher import watch

    settings = Settings.from_env()
    store = Store(settings.data_dir)
    notify = build_notifiers(settings.notifiers, settings.discord_webhook_url, settings.webhook_url)
    watch(
        store,
        PortalClient(settings.portal_url, settings.portal_token),
        _analyst(settings, store),
        notify,
        settings.interval_seconds,
        settings.notify_min_severity,
    )


def _escalation() -> None:
    from ask_soony.cli import _escalation_loop
    from ask_soony.config import Settings

    _escalation_loop(Settings.from_env())


def _guard(target):
    def run():
        try:
            target()
        except Exception as e:  # a crashed loop must not take the web server down
            print(f"background {target.__name__} stopped: {e}", file=sys.stderr)

    return run


def start() -> None:
    from ask_soony import replies

    if os.environ.get("ASK_BACKGROUND", "").lower() in ON:
        from ask_soony import anchors

        anchors.ensure_index()  # evidence anchoring: index portal files (cached by hash)
        from ask_soony import routines

        routines.start_background()  # routines the agent wrote, run in the Monty sandbox
        for loop in (_watcher, _escalation):
            threading.Thread(target=_guard(loop), daemon=True, name=loop.__name__).start()
        os.environ.setdefault("ASK_REPLY_POLL", "on")

"""
Demo cards from the real portal data: writes findings, decisions and impacts into data/state.

Every quantity, date, price and address on a card is read from the portal files at run time
(SAP exports, stock snapshot, pack-out log, supplier profiles). Only the document references live
in this script: which goods receipt or PO a case is about, which file and page shows the other
side, and the verbatim text that proves it. A case whose files or rows are missing, or whose
document no longer says what the script expects, is skipped with a warning.

Entries are merged by id (other entries stay), so running it twice changes nothing but the
timestamps. Nothing is approved and no email is sent.

    uv run python scripts/demo_cards.py            # add or refresh the demo cards
    uv run python scripts/demo_cards.py --reset    # also clear decisions, actions, replies,
                                                   # Teams posts and drafts; switch routines off

--reset first backs up every file it changes as <name>.before-demo-<timestamp>.json.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import re
import shutil
import sys
from datetime import datetime, time, timedelta
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "src"))
from ask_soony import api  # noqa: E402

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- document references (data)

ART_BOOKS = {
    "gr": "5000413065",
    "scan": "soony/receiving/DC-HAM/20261118_WZ-261116-473.jpg",
    "scan_quote": "Nr: WZ-261116-473 · Zamówienie: 4500318768 · CMP-GAM-008 · Ilość 80.000 "
    "(struck through), 8 000 (handwritten) · Waga brutto: 360 kg · Opak.: 40",
    "scan_translation": "Delivery note: the printed 80,000 is crossed out and corrected by hand "
    "to 8,000 (40 packages, 360 kg).",
    "offer": "suppliers/SUP-0028_Karton_Nowak/notices/Oferta_tryb_ekspresowy_2026-11-21.pdf",
    "offer_checks": ["8,000 pcs", "overrun from", "loaded"],
    "offer_quote": "CMP-GAM-008 Art Book Grand Heist 6 (96 p, hardcover) · 8 000 szt. / 8,000 pcs "
    "· overrun from production, in our finished-goods store · loaded within 4 h of your order",
    "offer_qty": 8000,
    "supplier_dir": "suppliers/SUP-0028_Karton_Nowak",
    "decide_by": time(10, 0),
    "lead_h": 1,
}

SLEEVES = {
    "ecn": "ECN-2026-118",
    "pos": ["4500318752", "4500318765", "4500318774", "4500318786"],
    "supplier_dir": "suppliers/SUP-0029_Guangzhou_PackRight",
    "supplier_part": "PR-SL-0604",
    "old_quote": "Artwork PR-SL-0604: rev. B (GH6_sleeve_revB.pdf)",
    # Karton Nowak already prints to the released file; its confirmations name it.
    "new_file_doc": "suppliers/SUP-0028_Karton_Nowak/order_confirmations/OA26293887_4500318775.pdf",
    "new_file": "GH6_sleeve_revC_USK2026.pdf",
    "decide_by": time(12, 0),
    "lead_h": 3,
}

STATUES = {
    "gr": "5000413063",
    "report": "soony/receiving/DC-HAM/inspection_report_5000413063.pdf",
    "report_checks": ["Lot does not meet AQL", "unrestricted", "concession"],
    "report_quote": "Goods receipt 5000413063 · 5,600 · 9 of 125 statues with paint defects. "
    "Lot does not meet AQL. Booked to stock as 'unrestricted' by receiving because the supplier "
    "is listed as active.",
    "decide_by": time(10, 0),
    "lead_h": 1,
}

RESET_FILES = {
    "decision_status.json": {},
    "actions.json": [],
    "replies_seen.json": [],
    "teams_posted.json": [],
    "routine_drafts.json": {},
}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- portal helpers


def warn(msg: str) -> None:
    print(f"warning: {msg}", file=sys.stderr)


def n(v) -> int:
    return int(api.num(v) or 0)


def fmt(v: float) -> str:
    return f"{v:,.0f}"


def fmt_date(value: str) -> str:
    try:
        return datetime.fromisoformat(value).strftime("%a %-d %b")
    except ValueError:
        return value


def csvs(root: Path, folder: str, pattern: str) -> list[dict]:
    rows: list[dict] = []
    for f in sorted((root / folder).glob(pattern)):
        rows += [{**r, "_file": str(f.relative_to(root))} for r in api.read_csv(f)]
    return rows


def pdf_text(path: Path) -> str:
    try:
        import pypdfium2 as pdfium

        doc = pdfium.PdfDocument(str(path))
        text = " ".join(page.get_textpage().get_text_range() for page in doc)
    except Exception:  # unreadable or not a PDF
        return ""
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text)


def says(root: Path, rel: str, checks: list[str]) -> bool:
    """The document exists and (for a PDF with a text layer) contains every check string."""
    path = root / rel
    if not path.is_file():
        warn(f"{rel} is missing")
        return False
    if path.suffix.lower() != ".pdf":
        return True
    text = pdf_text(path)
    missing = [c for c in checks if re.sub(r"\s+", " ", c) not in text]
    if missing:
        warn(f"{rel} no longer says {missing}")
    return not missing


def contact(root: Path, supplier_dir: str) -> dict:
    rows = api.read_csv(root / supplier_dir / "profile.csv")
    return rows[0] if rows else {}


def stock(root: Path) -> tuple[list[dict], str]:
    rows = csvs(root, "soony/erp", "stock_snapshot*.csv")
    return rows, max((r.get("snapshot_date") or "" for r in rows), default="")


def to_pack(root: Path, part: str, snapshot: str) -> tuple[str, int]:
    """Edition that needs this part and the copies still to pack as of the stock snapshot."""
    bom = [r for r in csvs(root, "soony/master", "bom.csv") if r.get("child_id") == part]
    launch = {
        r["product_id"]: r
        for r in csvs(root, "soony/master", "products.csv")
        if r.get("lifecycle") == "launch"
    }
    for b in bom:
        p = launch.get(b.get("parent_id") or "")
        if not p:
            continue
        packed = sum(
            n(r.get("units_packed"))
            for r in csvs(root, "soony/erp", "packout_log*.csv")
            if r.get("product_id") == p["product_id"] and (r.get("date") or "") <= snapshot
        )
        return p["product_id"], (n(p.get("day_one_qty")) - packed) * n(b.get("qty_per") or 1)
    return "", 0


def launch_day(root: Path) -> datetime:
    dates = [
        r["launch_date"]
        for r in csvs(root, "soony/master", "products.csv")
        if r.get("lifecycle") == "launch" and r.get("launch_date")
    ]
    day = datetime.fromisoformat(min(dates)) if dates else api.now()
    return day.replace(tzinfo=api.tz())


def deadline(root: Path, at: time, lead_h: float, cur: datetime) -> str:
    """The case's decide-by time on launch day, but never less than lead_h from now."""
    fixed = datetime.combine(launch_day(root).date(), at, tzinfo=api.tz())
    soon = cur + timedelta(hours=lead_h)
    soon = soon.replace(minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0) + timedelta(hours=1)
    return max(fixed, soon).isoformat()


def trail(cur: datetime, steps: list[tuple[str, str]]) -> list[dict]:
    start = cur - timedelta(minutes=2 * len(steps))
    return [
        {
            "agent": a,
            "at": (start + timedelta(minutes=2 * i)).isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
            "text": t,
        }
        for i, (a, t) in enumerate(steps)
    ]


def po_line(po: dict) -> str:
    return (
        f"PO {po['po_number']} line {po['po_line']} · {po['material_id']} · {po['quantity']} pcs "
        f"· promised {po['promised_date']} · {po['status']}"
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- cases


Card = tuple[dict, dict, dict]


def art_books(root: Path, cur: datetime) -> list[Card]:
    c = ART_BOOKS
    gr = next(
        (
            r
            for r in csvs(root, "soony/erp", "goods_receipts*.csv")
            if r.get("gr_number") == c["gr"]
        ),
        None,
    )
    if gr is None:
        warn(f"goods receipt {c['gr']} not found")
        return []
    if not (says(root, c["scan"], []) and says(root, c["offer"], c["offer_checks"])):
        return []
    part, po_no, ordered, booked = (
        gr["material_id"],
        gr["po_number"],
        n(gr["qty_ordered"]),
        n(gr["qty_received"]),
    )
    rows, snapshot = stock(root)
    system = sum(n(r.get("quantity")) for r in rows if r.get("material_id") == part)
    real = system - booked + ordered
    edition, need = to_pack(root, part, snapshot)
    short = max(0, need - real)
    po = next(
        (
            r
            for r in csvs(root, "soony/erp", "purchase_orders*.csv")
            if r.get("po_number") == po_no and r.get("po_line") == gr.get("po_line")
        ),
        {},
    )
    price, currency = api.num(po.get("unit_price")) or 0, po.get("currency") or "EUR"
    who = contact(root, c["supplier_dir"])
    offer_name = Path(c["offer"]).name
    fid = f"gr-{c['gr']}-{part}"
    finding = {
        "id": fid,
        "kind": "mismatch",
        "part": part,
        "supplier": gr.get("supplier_id"),
        "title": f"SAP counts {fmt(system)} art books; the shelf holds {fmt(real)}",

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- writing


def merge(name: str, key: str, entries: list[dict]) -> None:
    new = {e[key]: e for e in entries}
    kept = [e for e in api.read_list(name) if e.get(key) not in new]
    api.write_json(name, kept + list(new.values()))


def backup(name: str, stamp: str) -> None:
    path = api.state_dir() / name
    if path.exists():
        shutil.copy2(path, path.with_name(f"{path.stem}.before-demo-{stamp}.json"))


def reset(stamp: str) -> None:
    for name, empty in RESET_FILES.items():
        backup(name, stamp)
        api.write_json(name, empty)
    backup("routines.json", stamp)
    routines = api.read_list("routines.json")
    for r in routines:
        r["enabled"] = False
    api.write_json("routines.json", routines)


def build(root: Path, cur: datetime) -> list[Card]:
    cards: list[Card] = []
    for case in CASES:
        try:
            cards += case(root, cur)
        except (KeyError, ValueError) as exc:  # a file changed shape: skip this case only
            warn(f"{case.__name__} skipped: {exc!r}")
    return cards


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.split("\n\n")[0] if __doc__ else None)
    ap.add_argument("--reset", action="store_true", help="clear decisions, actions and routines")
    args = ap.parse_args(argv)
    root = api.portal_root()
    if root is None:
        print("No portal data found under data/ (set ASK_PORTAL_DIR).", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    cur = api.now()
    if args.reset:
        reset(cur.strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S"))
    cards = build(root, cur)
    merge("findings.json", "id", [f for f, _, _ in cards])
    merge("decisions.json", "finding_id", [d for _, d, _ in cards])
    merge("impacts.json", "finding_id", [i for _, _, i in cards])
    for f, d, _ in cards:
        print(f"{f['id']}: {d['headline']}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- portal helpers


def warn(msg: str) -> None:
    print(f"warning: {msg}", file=sys.stderr)


def n(v) -> int:
    return int(api.num(v) or 0)


def fmt(v: float) -> str:
    return f"{v:,.0f}"


def fmt_date(value: str) -> str:
    try:
        return datetime.fromisoformat(value).strftime("%a %-d %b")
    except ValueError:
        return value


def csvs(root: Path, folder: str, pattern: str) -> list[dict]:
    rows: list[dict] = []
    for f in sorted((root / folder).glob(pattern)):
        rows += [{**r, "_file": str(f.relative_to(root))} for r in api.read_csv(f)]
    return rows


def pdf_text(path: Path) -> str:
    try:
        import pypdfium2 as pdfium

        doc = pdfium.PdfDocument(str(path))
        text = " ".join(page.get_textpage().get_text_range() for page in doc)
    except Exception:  # unreadable or not a PDF
        return ""
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text)


def says(root: Path, rel: str, checks: list[str]) -> bool:
    """The document exists and (for a PDF with a text layer) contains every check string."""
    path = root / rel
    if not path.is_file():
        warn(f"{rel} is missing")
        return False
    if path.suffix.lower() != ".pdf":
        return True
    text = pdf_text(path)
    missing = [c for c in checks if re.sub(r"\s+", " ", c) not in text]
    if missing:
        warn(f"{rel} no longer says {missing}")
    return not missing


def contact(root: Path, supplier_dir: str) -> dict:
    rows = api.read_csv(root / supplier_dir / "profile.csv")
    return rows[0] if rows else {}


def stock(root: Path) -> tuple[list[dict], str]:
    rows = csvs(root, "soony/erp", "stock_snapshot*.csv")
    return rows, max((r.get("snapshot_date") or "" for r in rows), default="")


def to_pack(root: Path, part: str, snapshot: str) -> tuple[str, int]:
    """Edition that needs this part and the copies still to pack as of the stock snapshot."""
    bom = [r for r in csvs(root, "soony/master", "bom.csv") if r.get("child_id") == part]
    launch = {
        r["product_id"]: r
        for r in csvs(root, "soony/master", "products.csv")
        if r.get("lifecycle") == "launch"
    }
    for b in bom:
        p = launch.get(b.get("parent_id") or "")
        if not p:
            continue
        packed = sum(
            n(r.get("units_packed"))
            for r in csvs(root, "soony/erp", "packout_log*.csv")
            if r.get("product_id") == p["product_id"] and (r.get("date") or "") <= snapshot
        )
        return p["product_id"], (n(p.get("day_one_qty")) - packed) * n(b.get("qty_per") or 1)
    return "", 0


def launch_day(root: Path) -> datetime:
    dates = [
        r["launch_date"]
        for r in csvs(root, "soony/master", "products.csv")
        if r.get("lifecycle") == "launch" and r.get("launch_date")
    ]
    day = datetime.fromisoformat(min(dates)) if dates else api.now()
    return day.replace(tzinfo=api.tz())


def deadline(root: Path, at: time, lead_h: float, cur: datetime) -> str:
    """The case's decide-by time on launch day, but never less than lead_h from now."""
    fixed = datetime.combine(launch_day(root).date(), at, tzinfo=api.tz())
    soon = cur + timedelta(hours=lead_h)
    soon = soon.replace(minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0) + timedelta(hours=1)
    return max(fixed, soon).isoformat()


def trail(cur: datetime, steps: list[tuple[str, str]]) -> list[dict]:
    start = cur - timedelta(minutes=2 * len(steps))
    return [
        {
            "agent": a,
            "at": (start + timedelta(minutes=2 * i)).isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
            "text": t,
        }
        for i, (a, t) in enumerate(steps)
    ]

                    "failed incoming inspection but is booked unrestricted. Without it we are "
                    f"{fmt(short)} Collector's copies short. Please decide today: a concession "
                    "or a 100% sort at DC Hamburg."
                ),
            },
        ],
    }

        "finding_id": fid,
        "copies_at_risk": short,
        "edition": edition,
        "deadline": decision["deadline"],
    }
    return [(finding, decision, impact)]


CASES = (art_books, sleeves, statues)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- writing


def merge(name: str, key: str, entries: list[dict]) -> None:
    new = {e[key]: e for e in entries}
    kept = [e for e in api.read_list(name) if e.get(key) not in new]
    api.write_json(name, kept + list(new.values()))


def backup(name: str, stamp: str) -> None:
    path = api.state_dir() / name
    if path.exists():
        shutil.copy2(path, path.with_name(f"{path.stem}.before-demo-{stamp}.json"))


def reset(stamp: str) -> None:
    for name, empty in RESET_FILES.items():
        backup(name, stamp)
        api.write_json(name, empty)
    backup("routines.json", stamp)
    routines = api.read_list("routines.json")
    for r in routines:
        r["enabled"] = False
    api.write_json("routines.json", routines)


def build(root: Path, cur: datetime) -> list[Card]:
    cards: list[Card] = []
    for case in CASES:
        try:
            cards += case(root, cur)
        except (KeyError, ValueError) as exc:  # a file changed shape: skip this case only
            warn(f"{case.__name__} skipped: {exc!r}")
    return cards


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.split("\n\n")[0] if __doc__ else None)
    ap.add_argument("--reset", action="store_true", help="clear decisions, actions and routines")
    args = ap.parse_args(argv)
    root = api.portal_root()
    if root is None:
        print("No portal data found under data/ (set ASK_PORTAL_DIR).", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    cur = api.now()
    if args.reset:
        reset(cur.strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S"))
    cards = build(root, cur)
    merge("findings.json", "id", [f for f, _, _ in cards])
    merge("decisions.json", "finding_id", [d for _, d, _ in cards])
    merge("impacts.json", "finding_id", [i for _, _, i in cards])
    for f, d, _ in cards:
        print(f"{f['id']}: {d['headline']}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""
Background loops of the product, started inside the dashboard app so everything runs as one
server: the portal watcher, alert escalation and the supplier reply poller.

Only with ASK_BACKGROUND=on in the process environment (tests and local UI work stay quiet).
ASK_REPLY_POLL=on alone still starts just the reply poller.
"""

import os
import sys
import threading

ON = ("1", "on", "true", "yes")


def _watcher() -> None:
    from ask_soony.cli import _analyst
    from ask_soony.config import Settings
    from ask_soony.notify import build_notifiers
    from ask_soony.portal import PortalClient
    from ask_soony.store import Store
    from ask_soony.watcher import watch

    settings = Settings.from_env()
    store = Store(settings.data_dir)
    notify = build_notifiers(settings.notifiers, settings.discord_webhook_url, settings.webhook_url)
    watch(
        store,
        PortalClient(settings.portal_url, settings.portal_token),
        _analyst(settings, store),
        notify,
        settings.interval_seconds,
        settings.notify_min_severity,
    )


def _escalation() -> None:
    from ask_soony.cli import _escalation_loop
    from ask_soony.config import Settings

    _escalation_loop(Settings.from_env())


def _guard(target):
    def run():
        try:
            target()
        except Exception as e:  # a crashed loop must not take the web server down
            print(f"background {target.__name__} stopped: {e}", file=sys.stderr)

    return run


def start() -> None:
    from ask_soony import replies

    if os.environ.get("ASK_BACKGROUND", "").lower() in ON:
        from ask_soony import anchors

        anchors.ensure_index()  # evidence anchoring: index portal files (cached by hash)
        from ask_soony import routines

        routines.start_background()  # routines the agent wrote, run in the Monty sandbox
        for loop in (_watcher, _escalation):
            threading.Thread(target=_guard(loop), daemon=True, name=loop.__name__).start()
        os.environ.setdefault("ASK_REPLY_POLL", "on")
    replies.start_background()
    from ask_soony import teams

    teams.start_background()  # ASK_TEAMS=on: post new launch alerts to a Teams channel
"""
Settings from environment variables, with an optional .env file in the working directory.

Nothing about the customer's data lives here: only where to find the portal, which model to
use and where to send notifications.
"""

import os
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path


def load_dotenv(path: Path = Path(".env")) -> None:
    """Load KEY=VALUE lines into os.environ without overriding variables that are already set."""
    if not path.exists():
        return
    for raw in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        line = raw.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith("#") or "=" not in line:
            continue
        key, value = line.split("=", 1)
        value = value.strip().strip('"').strip("'")
        # Empty template lines must not shadow credentials the SDKs find elsewhere.
        if value:
            os.environ.setdefault(key.strip(), value)


def _env(name: str, default: str = "") -> str:
    return os.environ.get(name, default).strip()


@dataclass
class Settings:
    portal_url: str
    portal_token: str
    data_dir: Path
    # LLM: "anthropic", "openai" (OpenAI or any OpenAI-compatible server such as llama.cpp)
    # or "none" (poll and store only).
    llm_provider: str
    llm_model: str
    llm_base_url: str
    llm_api_key: str
    llm_effort: str
    interval_seconds: int
    notifiers: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    discord_webhook_url: str = ""
    webhook_url: str = ""
    # Findings at or above this severity are pushed to the notifiers.
    notify_min_severity: str = "high"
    dashboard_password: str = ""
    dashboard_port: int = 8765
    alert_policy: Path = Path("data/alert-policy.json")
    call_provider: str = "dry_run"
    public_url: str = ""

    @classmethod
    def from_env(cls) -> "Settings":
        load_dotenv()
        # Fall back to OpenAI when only an OpenAI key is configured.
        only_openai = _env("OPENAI_API_KEY") and not _env("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY")
        fallback = "openai" if only_openai else "anthropic"
        provider = _env("ASK_LLM_PROVIDER", fallback).lower()
        portal_url = _env("SOONY_PORTAL_URL") or _env("URL")
        if portal_url and "://" not in portal_url:
            portal_url = "https://" + portal_url
        default_model = {"anthropic": "claude-opus-5-5", "openai": "gpt-5"}.get(provider, "")
        notifiers = [n.strip() for n in _env("ASK_NOTIFIERS", "console").split(",") if n.strip()]
        return cls(
            portal_url=portal_url.rstrip("/"),
            portal_token=REDACTED or _env("TOKEN"),
            data_dir=Path(_env("ASK_DATA_DIR", "data/store")),
            llm_provider=provider,
            llm_model=_env("ASK_LLM_MODEL", default_model),
            llm_base_url=_env("ASK_LLM_BASE_URL"),
            llm_api_key=REDACTED,
            llm_effort=_env("ASK_LLM_EFFORT", "medium"),
            interval_seconds=int(_env("ASK_INTERVAL_SECONDS", "300")),
            notifiers=notifiers,
            discord_webhook_url=_env("ASK_DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL"),
            webhook_url=_env("ASK_WEBHOOK_URL"),
            notify_min_severity=_env("ASK_NOTIFY_MIN_SEVERITY", "high").lower(),
            dashboard_password=_env("ASK_DASHBOARD_PASSWORD"),
            dashboard_port=int(_env("ASK_DASHBOARD_PORT", "8765")),
            alert_policy=Path(_env("ASK_ALERT_POLICY", "data/alert-policy.json")),
            call_provider=_env("ASK_CALL_PROVIDER", "dry_run").lower(),
            public_url=_env("ASK_PUBLIC_URL").rstrip("/"),
        )
"""
Evidence anchoring: find where a card's numbers and ids actually appear in the portal documents,
down to the PDF page, the scanned word or the spreadsheet row, so the UI can open the file there
and highlight it.

Every portal file is indexed once (cached by content hash under <ASK_DATA_DIR>/anchors/):
- PDF pages with a text layer: words with their boxes (pypdfium2)
- scanned PDF pages and images: words with boxes from local OCR (tesseract; Latin models are
  enough because numbers and ids are written in Latin script in every supplier language)
- CSV / XLSX: one unit per row; JSON, Markdown, text and mail: one unit per line

A card's evidence is turned into search tokens (numbers with thousands separators removed, ids
like PO, shipment or part numbers) and matched against the index; units sharing the most tokens,
boosted by the card's part, shipment and supplier, become anchors. Nothing about Soony is
hardcoded: it works on whatever files the portal holds.
"""

import csv
import hashlib
import io
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import threading
from pathlib import Path

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException
from fastapi.responses import Response

router = APIRouter()
_lock = threading.Lock()
_index: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}  # doc path -> units
_state = {"building": False, "done": False, "files": 0}

TEXT_SUFFIXES = {".json", ".md", ".txt", ".eml", ".html", ".xml"}

def _watcher() -> None:

def _guard(target):
    def run():
        try:

        except Exception as e:  # a crashed loop must not take the web server down

    """Load KEY=VALUE lines into os.environ without overriding variables that are already set."""
    if not path.exists():

    for raw in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():

import re

ROW = re.compile(r"(\d{5}) (\S+) (.+?) ([\d,]+) ([\d.]+) ([A-Z]{3}) (\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})")
for d, us in sorted(anchors._index.items()):
    if not d.startswith("suppliers/") or d.endswith((".csv",".json",".xlsx")) or "contracts/" in d: continue
    for u in us:
        t = u.get("text") or " ".join(w[0] for w in u.get("words", []))
        rows = ROW.findall(t)
        tail = t
        m = list(ROW.finditer(t))
        if m: tail = t[m[-1].end():]
        if tail.strip() or not rows:
            print("==", d, u.get("source"), len(rows)); print("   ", tail.strip()[:400])
EOF

"""Packing clock: shift windows, pack rates and remaining copies, read from the portal files.

The launch plan workbook holds a shift table (rows like 'Saturday | 06:00–22:00') and an editions
table (product, packed, rate per hour). Sheets and columns are found by their headers, so a new
version of the plan is read without code changes. Packed copies come from the pack-out log when it
is newer than the plan. Nothing about Soony is written here.

A packed figure carries the time it was counted when its sheet states one ('status 2026-11-20
18:00', 'Saturday 13:00') or, for the pack-out log, the end of its last day. From then on the
lines are assumed to pack at their plan rate inside shifts (the plan's own assumption), so a status
from Saturday noon still says how far the cell is on Sunday. Parts shortfalls are separate: they
stop a line early (line_stops).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import csv
import re
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

_TIMES = re.compile(r"(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})\s*[–—-]\s*(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})")
_STAMP_ISO = re.compile(r"(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})[ T](\d{1,2}):(\d{2})")
_STAMP_DAY = re.compile(r"\b(monday|tuesday|wednesday|thursday|friday|saturday|sunday)\s+(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})", re.I)
# The challenge brief's shifts, used only when no plan workbook states any: no night shift.
DEFAULT_SHIFTS = [("saturday", "06:00–22:00"), ("sunday", "06:00–20:00")]
WEEKDAYS = ["monday", "tuesday", "wednesday", "thursday", "friday", "saturday", "sunday"]


@dataclass
class EditionPlan:
    product: str
    label: str | None = None
    day_one: float | None = None
    packed: float | None = None
    rate_per_hour: float | None = None
    packed_as_of: datetime | None = None  # when `packed` was counted, if a source says so
